newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 26.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan, China both campaign for World Trade Organisation entry at Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum.
Police suspect murderer of Taoyuan county magistrate and seven others had mapped out escape route prior to killings.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Police arrest video game parlour owner for suspected arson.
Malaysia plans to build world's largest free trade zone.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Short-term interest rates soar following stock market rises.
Leaders attending APEC forum say all APEC members should be WTO members.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Stock market climbs to new high in hectic turnover.
Industry leaders object to proposal giving two off days to government workers.
